comments.content: The manual test check uses `testName` (capitalized first letter) to look up `manualTests`, but `makeManual.mts` writes the raw `testName` argument into `manualTests.txt`. If the user passes a lowercase test name (e.g. `npm run makemanual completionsAt`), the file will contain `completionsAt` while `convertFourslash` checks for `CompletionsAt`, so the test will not be skipped and will be regenerated into `gen/`. Normalize the name consistently in both scripts (e.g. capitalize in `makeManual.mts` before writing, or compare case-insensitively).

`testFileName` is set to `testName` directly, but the generated files in `gen/` are named `${test.name}_test.go` (see convertFourslash.mts). Unless the caller passes the full filename including the `_test.go` suffix, `fs.existsSync(genTestFile)` will always fail. Consider appending `_test.go` (or documenting that the full filename is required) so the script works with the same test name used elsewhere.
